SMART COCKPIT TECHNOLOGY
All Durango trim levels flex a race-inspired cockpit with styling cues borrowed from the Dodge Challenger. The sleek dash leans in toward the driver for ergonomic
comfort, while the instrument panel showcases a 7-inch Thin Film Transistor (TFT) cluster design with full-color graphics. The available flat-bottom steering wheel
takes its performance feel to the next level with available paddle shifters. The standard Uconnect® 4 includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, while the available Uconnect 5
radio features a 10.1-inch touchscreen display. An integrated control switch bank adds quick access to available heated front seats and heated steering wheel
controls. Having multiple devices that require different types of charging cords isn’t a problem. The center console houses an auxiliary input and two sets of USB
connections (Type-A/-C pairs). Need more? Opt for a second-row console that also has Type-A and Type-C USB ports.
Durango SRT® shown with available Laguna leather trim in Black and Demonic Red.

TOWING LEGEND:
8,700 LB
WITH THE 6.4L HEMI®
V8 ENGINE
8,700 REASONS TO TOW // This is the SUV that hauls from both ends. The lineup
starts with up to 8,700 lb of towing on SRT® models equipped with the 6.4L HEMI V8
as well as on R/T models equipped with the Tow N Go Package. Trim levels mated to
the available 360-horsepower 5.7L HEMI V8 engine and available Trailer-Tow Group IV
offer up to 7,200 lb of towing. When the 3.6L Pentastar® V6 engine is under the hood,
Durango models can tow up to an impressive 6,200 lb.
Durango SRT Hellcat® shown in Destroyer Grey with available Gunmetal Low-Gloss dual graphic
stripes, SRT Black Package and Trailer-Tow Group IV.
